evals.name: escaped-regression-to-driver
evals.prompt: open reported success when the domain filter blocked a redirect (fixed in #2114). Make sure this never ships again.
evals.expected_output: An assertion in a domain-redirect driver that fails with the fix reverted and passes with it applied, both outputs shown, an ENFORCERS row, and the case Enforcer field set.
assertions: Recreates the mistaken state by reverting the fix
Shows the enforcer failing on the mistake and passing on the fix
Chooses a driver assertion over a hook
Adds an ENFORCERS.md row and sets the Enforcer field

evals.name: repeat-mistake-escalates
evals.prompt: The agent claimed done again without looking at the screenshot, even though the feature file says to look. Correct it.
evals.expected_output: The enforcer moves one level up from the prose feature note, for example a driver assertion on visible text or the Stop hook requiring fresh evidence, with the reason the lower level missed it.
assertions: Recognizes the existing prose rule as the lower level that missed
Escalates exactly one level with a stated reason
Proves the new enforcer fails on the mistaken state
